page_title: PSG 3-0 MNT | PSG v Montpellier 03/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Montpellier.

90+6' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Montpellier.
90+3' Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
88' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
88' Montpellier force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Montpellier win a corner kick.
85' Paris SG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
83' Here is a change. Mousa Al-Tamari is going off and Michel Der Zakarian gives the last tactical orders to Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier).
83' Substitution. Sacha Delaye (Montpellier) in, Akor Adams out.
82' Nordi Mukiele (Paris SG) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Carlos Soler (Paris SG) is replacing Achraf Hakimi.
78' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Warren Zaire-Emery will be replaced by Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG).
76' What a great effort! Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
74' The ball possession is 71:29.
71' Substitution. Marquinhos makes his way off the pitch and Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) comes on as his replacement.
70' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to make a change. Leo Leroy (Montpellier) replaces Jordan Ferri.
69' Substitution. Khalil Fayad leaves the pitch and is replaced by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
66' 3 - 0 Goal - 3:0! Vitinha (Paris SG) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Achraf Hakimi provided an assist for the goal.
64' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
64' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out of play. Paris SG are awarded a corner kick.
63' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
62' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Randal Kolo Muani and he is replaced by Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG).
61' The substitution is prepared. Vitinha (Paris SG) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kang-In Lee.
61' Looks like Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
58' 2 - 0 It's 2:0! Ousmane Dembele feeds Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the right side of the net.
57' Nordi Mukiele (Paris SG) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
56' The resulting corner from Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) comes to nothing.
56' Nordi Mukiele (Paris SG) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

55' Nordi Mukiele (Paris SG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Paris SG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' The corner from Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) is hurriedly cleared.
52' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) takes the corner which is cleared. Corner kick. Paris SG will have an opportunity.
51' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Paris SG.

50' Benjamin Lecomte pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom left corner, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
49' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
48' A cross into the box from Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) is cleared.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Paris SG take a short corner kick.

45+3' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Paris SG force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45+2' Flag up against Akor Adams (Montpellier). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The resulting corner from Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
42' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Paris SG as they win a corner.
41' Nordi Mukiele (Paris SG) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ruddy Buquet saw the whole situation.
39' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gianluigi Donnarumma intercepts the ball.
37' Good movement by Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
35' Akor Adams (Montpellier) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
33' 7:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
31' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Benjamin Lecomte.
27' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
27' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

26' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) produced a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Benjamin Lecomte thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
25' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
22' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

22' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Paris SG.
22' The corner from Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) is intercepted by the defence.
21' Issiaga Sylla is substituted due to injury. Michel Der Zakarian gives a chance to Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier).
21' Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Paris SG have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

15' That didn't go as planned! Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Benjamin Lecomte, who easily kept it out.
13' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) commits a foul and Ruddy Buquet immediately signals a free kick.
10' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the top left corner. Achraf Hakimi provided an assist for the goal.
6' The Paris SG players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) inside the box.
1' The match has just started.
Paris SG will kick-off.
Ruddy Buquet will officiate today.
